# SortController

> Manages column sort state and dispatches `native:sort` events.

## Constructor

```ts
new SortController(host: HTMLElement, options?: SortOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `selector` | `string` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly |
|----------|------|----------|
| `sortDirection` | `SortDirection` | yes |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:sort` | `{ column, direction }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { SortController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new SortController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
